title: Decision type
description: Architecture/operating decision record (ADR). Status vocabulary and link fields aligned to adroit's Adr/Status (adroit/src/adr.rs); numbering deliberately absent — it belongs to the head (kb-spike#6). Confidence is deliberately absent: decisions never declare it and are un-stale by design (kb-spike findings/issue-03, issue-04).

id.description: Stable opaque page identifier (ULID, tool-generated). Links target this, not the path (kb-spike#1).

reference.description: Head-owned display identity (e.g. ADR-0006, 20260720-use-postgres). Allocated and written by adroit; the substrate only stores it (kb-spike#6). Distinct from id (routing identity).

status.description: Decision lifecycle, aligned to adroit Status

created.description: ISO 8601 date the decision record was created

supersedes.description: Id (preferred) or slug of the older decision this one replaces

superseded_by.description: Id (preferred) or slug of the newer decision replacing this one

depends_on.description: Ids/slugs of decisions this one depends on

refines.description: Ids/slugs of decisions this one refines

review_by.description: Review deadline while status is proposed

last_updated.description: ISO 8601 date of last substantive edit

citations.description: Pinned path@commit evidence refs. Non-edge by design — interim home until the citation link kind lands (llm-wiki#8); edge fields would mis-parse pinned refs as slugs (kb-spike findings/issue-09).
